essence: Kauśa, girikarṇī, and diminishing kaṭambharā are to be included as ritual substances.
Śatāvarī and somavallī must be placed in the ritual pots.
The worship must include scents, flowers, incense, lamps, and food offerings.
Oblations should be made in the fire pit as before, with the previous materials and in due order.
Accompanied by two physicians, one should proceed with the horse facing east.
